summary.text: Immortal aperture transplantation is a way of relocating a blessed land that uses a set of sixteen Immortal Gu.

claims.text: Fang Yuan goes to Lang Ya blessed land to borrow Lang Ya land spirit’s set of Immortal Gu for relocating his blessed land. The land spirit says the set will not be cheap and that Fang Yuan must pay two thousand immortal essence stones even though he fought strong enemies for Lang Ya blessed land, and Fang Yuan hands over the two thousand stones. After he pays, he and the land spirit use an information path immortal killer move to form an agreement, and he gives the land spirit two Immortal Gu as collateral before he borrows a set of Immortal Gu used to relocate blessed lands, sixteen of them.

In Star Form blessed land he spends seven days and six nights deducing with the wisdom path Immortal Gu he borrowed, then obtains two Gu formation charts, one big and one small. The bigger chart reflects Star Form blessed land and has eight formation cores; the smaller reflects a spinefin star dragonfish and has four formation cores. Each core needs a specific Immortal Gu, twelve in total.

Old Immortal Kong Jue named the immortal killer move of relocating blessed lands the immortal aperture transplantation method. It can use up to sixteen core Immortal Gu, the highest number of cores Fang Yuan has seen in an immortal killer move at that point, and it remains incomplete. Kong Jue’s aim was to transplant a Gu Immortal’s immortal aperture into a desolate beast or ancient desolate beast perfectly. As left behind, two Gu formations only join the two with great immortal essence cost and only for a short time. Long Hair Ancestor obtained the inheritance and failed to complete it. Under Immortal Yi Yan’s inspection he still found shocking value in relocating the immortal apertures of dead Gu Immortals.

Fang Yuan transplants Star Form blessed land into a spinefin star dragonfish in Earth Abyss. He places the eight Immortal Gu at the formation cores in the blessed land and the four on the body of the dragonfish, then activates the remaining four to carry out the transfer. The blessed land must be transplanted into a desolate beast or ancient desolate beast, which can then bring the immortal aperture wherever it is moved. While the aperture rides in the beast, the host cannot store another immortal aperture or use Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan cannot store the host in his own aperture or help it with other Immortal Gu or immortal killer moves, and outside influence can collapse the formations and destroy the Immortal Gu used. The host can only rely on its own physical strength to move, and the method cuts its speed to less than half, which limits the distance of each relocation. When the aperture is removed, the host dies. Even an uninjured host would die from exhaustion at the destination.

Known users.text: Old Immortal Kong Jue (creator) Fang Yuan
